title: incident-bot: auto-link runbooks and SLO context in on-call diagnostics
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds automatic runbook linking and SLO context enrichment to incident-bot on-call diagnostics; behind feature flag; minor telemetry additions.
commits: feat: runbook auto-linking pipeline and match heuristics
feat: enrich on-call diagnostics with SLO context from slo-toolkit
test: unit + integration tests for runbook matcher and telemetry
fix: concurrency guard for async suggestions worker
body: Motivation: on recent incidents the on-call flow required copying links from the SLO runbook dashboard into the incident thread. This PR adds automatic runbook discovery and linking inside incident-bot's on-call diagnostics flow and enriches diagnostic messages with SLO context pulled from slo-toolkit. Goals: make it easier for responders to find relevant runbooks, reduce time-to-mitigation, and provide observable telemetry for adoption. Summary of changes: 1) Implemented a lightweight runbook matcher (services/incident-bot/src/runbooks/auto_linker.py) that takes incident tags, alert title, and SLO metadata to score candidate runbooks. 2) Diagnostics enricher (services/incident-bot/src/oncall/diagnostics_enricher.py) attaches top-ranked runbook links and a short SLO summary to on-call messages. 3) Added a thin client to slo-toolkit (pkg/slo-toolkit/client.py) to fetch SLO metadata and pre-computed runbook mappings. 4) Worker changes to suggestions_worker to make runbook linking async with retries and a concurrency guard. 5) Tests: unit tests for matcher and integration test covering end-to-end enrichment + telemetry. 6) Infra: feature flag to gate rollout and Helm value to disable by default; observability events added to track suggestion shown/accepted. Checklist: - [x] Implementation + tests - [x] Docs (docs/runbooks/oncall-integration.md) - [x] Feature flag behind rollout config - [x] Telemetry events defined - [x] Manual e2e smoke run (scripts/e2e/incident-oncall-smoke.sh) Rollout plan: enable behind feature flag for 10% of on-call rotations for first week, monitor suggestion_shown / suggestion_accepted metrics, iterate on heuristics. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged when feature flag is off. Performance: async worker and caching in slo-toolkit client added to avoid blocking request path. Observability: added events suggestion_shown, suggestion_accepted, suggestion_failed; logs include runbook_id and match_score (PII-free). Security: runbook links are URLs to internal docs only; client uses service token scoped to read-only SLO metadata. Notes on implementation details: - Matcher uses a combination of tag overlap, title TF-IDF similarity (precomputed vectors), and SLO priority weighting; tuned thresholds to prioritize precision at the cost of recall for initial rollout. - Added unit tests with synthetic runbook sets and recorded expected match order. - Integration test spins up a lightweight slo-toolkit test stub to validate end-to-end attach. CI: initial CI run failed due to a race in suggestions_worker (tests intermittently hit concurrency limit). Fix applied (concurrency guard and additional wait in tests) and pipeline re-run passed. Review highlights: requested additional telemetry fields (added), requested clearer docs for feature flag (updated docs), asked for small refactor to client backoff (done). Merge: squashed and merged after approvals.
review_comments: Liam Chen (reviewer): Please make sure we don't expose runbook content—only links and summary; consider redaction. Updated docs mention link-only behavior.
Priya Kapoor (reviewer): Tests flaked in CI; can you add a small concurrency guard? Author added guard and re-ran CI.
Jared Kim (approver): Approve after telemetry events added and rollout config documented. Verified smoke run for 10% feature flag.
Ava Martinez (author reply): Addressed review comments; added backoff to slo-toolkit client and feature flag docs; expanded integration test to include telemetry assertion.
merge_outcome: Squash merged to main after approvals and CI green; deployment rolled to 10% via feature flag on 2026-02-23.
